title: Obligra Resource Hub: 14 polished social explainers
scope: Nine shortlisted SVGs plus five supporting concept diagrams. Quickstart journey and After this quickstart excluded pending onboarding reconciliation.
usage: Use PNGs for social-image attachments. Link the relevant source page in post copy. These are conceptual summaries, not proof that every described feature or integration was production-tested.

items.title: When review starts from fragments
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  01 AUDIT REVIEW When review starts from fragments Without a retained decision record, the review can become reconstruction. A reviewer asks: “What happened in this decision?” Logs System activity Tickets Human annotations Screenshots Visible UI state Dashboards Aggregate behavior Emails Correspondence Manual reconstruction Find, compare and assemble the fragments. Audit response These sources can help. They are not, by themselves, the retained decision artifact. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Reconstruction is conditional rather than inevitable; source categories preserved.

items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  02 AUDIT REVIEW Begin with the retained record Use business context to locate the evidence your application supplied. 1 Business identifier Case · claim · transaction · encounter · workflow 2 Retained decision record Selected context captured at execution time Review history Supplied approvals, overrides and escalations Verification Check whether the record still matches what was captured Evidence Submitted input, context, output and workflow metadata Review depends on what was supplied. items.title: Verified does not mean correct
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  03 VERIFICATION SCOPE Verified does not mean correct An integrity result answers a different question from a decision review. VERIFICATION ASKS Does the retained record still match what was captured? It does not establish: Correct outcome Was this the right decision? Complete, accurate input Was the source data good enough? Appropriate model Was this the right model to use? Regulatory compliance Did the decision meet the standard? Integrity supports review. Correctness, input quality, model choice and compliance remain separate. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves integrity versus correctness, input quality, model choice and compliance distinction.

items.title: Verify on AWS: who runs what?
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  05 REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE Verify on AWS: who runs what? Customer-owned capture. Obligra-operated record services. 01  CUSTOMER AWS ACCOUNT Application runtime + business data ECS · EKS · Lambda · EC2 · App Runner API keys stay in customer-managed secret storage. 02  CUSTOMER-OWNED CAPTURE BOUNDARY Customer-owned proxy The application supplies context; the proxy applies policy. Capture decision Capture this interaction, or skip it. Field retention Allow, drop, redact or truncate fields. Only approved fields leave this boundary HTTPS 03  OBLIGRA MANAGED PLATFORM Verify API → Decision record platform → Console Retention · retrieval · verification · evidence A reference pattern, not automatic capture. Customer policy determines what is submitted. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves three zones and policy-before-egress semantics. Deployment tool/SDK specifics omitted from this visual summary.

items.title: From workflow to review evidence
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  06 VERIFY LIFECYCLE From workflow to review evidence A record of selected evidence, retained for authorized review. 01 Workflow An AI-assisted step occurs. CUSTOMER 02 Capture Select and supply context. CUSTOMER 03 Retain Hold the submitted record. OBLIGRA 04 Retrieve Find it by business context. OBLIGRA 05 Verify Check the record’s integrity. OBLIGRA 06 Evidence Use it in a review workflow. CUSTOMER REVIEW Verification checks the retained artifact. It does not establish that the decision was right. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Six lifecycle stages preserved. Evidence is shown being used by customer reviewers rather than implying a guaranteed compliance result.

items.title: An audit question needs evidence
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  07 QUESTIONS TO RECORDS An audit question needs evidence Five questions and the record evidence a reviewer should inspect. QUESTION EVIDENCE TO INSPECT 01 What happened? Workflow context 02 Who approved it? Supplied review history 03 What controls applied? Validation state 04 Was it changed? Lifecycle + integrity result 05 Does integrity hold? Verification state Inspect the facts actually supplied. A field or “verified” status alone does not answer every audit question. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves five audit questions; review history is supplied, and change review includes the integrity result. Removes claim every answer is guaranteed to exist.

items.title: The boundary is the concept
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  08 ARCHITECTURE DEFINITIONS The boundary is the concept The customer-owned proxy is an implementation of that boundary. ARCHITECTURAL CONCEPT Customer-owned capture boundary Where the customer decides what becomes a record and which fields may leave their environment. Commonly implemented by CUSTOMER-DEPLOYED SERVICE Customer-owned proxy 1 Capture policy Capture or skip 2 Field policy Choose allowed fields 3 Forwarder Send approved payload The customer runs the proxy. The boundary describes the responsibility, not a separate product. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Concept versus implementation and three proxy responsibilities preserved. Deployment tooling details omitted.

items.title: Three questions. Three meanings.
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  09 REVIEW VOCABULARY Three questions. Three meanings. Validation, verification and correctness must stay separate. 01 Validation Did the submission meet the record contract? Verify · at submission 02 Verification Does the retained record still match capture? Verify · on-demand integrity check 03 Correctness Was this the right outcome for the situation? Customer review program · domain judgment A valid submission and an unchanged record do not establish a correct, complete or compliant decision. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves submission validation, record integrity verification, and customer-owned correctness review.

items.title: Build trust one check at a time
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  11 VERIFICATION LIFECYCLE Build trust one check at a time Each stage answers a specific question about the retained record. 01 Captured EXECUTION TIME Does the record exist? The selected evidence was recorded. 02 Validated EXECUTION TIME Did the submission conform? Its shape met the submission contract. 03 Attested EXECUTION TIME Can integrity be checked later? An integrity reference was committed. 04 Verified REVIEW TIME Does it still match capture? An on-demand check tests the retained record. 05 Reviewed REVIEW TIME Has a reviewer acted on it? The customer program inspected or escalated it. A saved result is time-stamped history. Use a fresh integrity check when current verification is needed. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves five lifecycle concepts; replaces generic cumulative-trust ranking with checkable properties and saved-result timing caveat.

items.title: Five things a reviewer needs
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  12 AUDIT REVIEW STARTING POINT Five things a reviewer needs Start with the record, then inspect what it actually contains. 01 Context Case, claim, transaction or workflow 02 Controls Submitted policies and validation rules 03 Review history Supplied approvals, overrides and escalations 04 Verification Integrity result, lifecycle state and check time 05 Evidence Input, context, output and workflow metadata A record can bring these together when supplied. It cannot fill in missing events, actors or reasons. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source

items.title: Capture once. Review over time.
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  13 END-TO-END LIFECYCLE Capture once. Review over time. A customer-controlled path from an AI-assisted step to a reviewed record. 01 CUSTOMER AI-assisted workflow The customer application runs the workflow. 02 CUSTOMER Decision context assembled The application selects input, context, output and identifiers. 03 CUSTOMER Approved submission The proxy applies capture and field-retention policy. 04 OBLIGRA Record retained Verify retains and indexes the record, with an integrity reference. 05 OBLIGRA Retrieved and verified An authorized reviewer locates it and checks integrity. 06 CUSTOMER REVIEW Reviewed Customer reviewers inspect, act on or escalate the record. The customer controls the evidence supplied. Review can recur throughout the record’s retained life. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Preserves six stages and customer/platform/reviewer boundaries. Submission is explicitly customer-selected.

items.title: Choose runtime and governance
items.alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  14 INTEGRATION ARCHITECTURE Choose runtime and governance Two independent choices. The same Verify API destination. 01  WHERE DOES CAPTURE EXECUTE? Backend service Existing request path AWS Lambda Event-driven function Container / ECS Long-running service Queue worker Asynchronous processing 02  HOW IS CAPTURE GOVERNED? Direct integration A direct submission path, commonly used for evaluation. Customer runtime Verify API Governed integration Customer policy is evaluated before transmission. Runtime Customer proxy + policies Verify API The queue, worker and proxy remain customer-owned. Use the runtime that fits the workflow and the governance pattern its review obligations require. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
items.editorial_note: Reorganizes the original 4×2 matrix into independent runtime and governance choices. Avoids suggesting direct integration is forbidden in production.
